description: Cancel a Fold order. Allowed only before the driver has picked up the bag — after pickup, items have to be returned unprocessed instead (the customer should call support). Requires the order code and the email used when scheduling. Returns the new state and confirms the saved card was not charged.

email.description: Email used when scheduling. Not needed when the customer has connected their Fold account.

orderCode.description: Order code like FHL-RRKU92 or FOLD-K9ZGQ.

reason.description: Optional reason — shown to ops, helps us improve.

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel order
